name: Thieves
overview: Scripture reveals that thieves are characterized by their intent to steal, kill, and destroy, standing in stark contrast to Christ who offers abundant life (John 10:10). Jesus condemns those who have turned the temple into a 'den of thieves,' highlighting the corruption and exploitation within what should be a house of prayer (Matthew 21:13; Mark 11:17; Luke 19:46). Additionally, the presence of two thieves crucified alongside Christ underscores the reality of sin and judgment, even as Christ's sacrifice offers redemption (Matthew 27:38, 44).
